citation: "South Water Street." Chicagology. Quoting the Chicago American, 9 July 1836.
note: The Frog Pond: 'a pond of water on Lake Street, corner of La Salle, inhabited by frogs. It smells strong now, and in a few days will send out a horrible stench.' Dated 9 July 1836 — the same season, one year after the scene date, one block from the Public Square. The best-dated July fauna and standing-water fact available.
